propositions.statement: A system can be in a definite state of rest, distinct from the state of a system with translation.

propositions.name: true_time_distinct_from_local_time
propositions.statement: There is a general time distinct from the auxiliary variable t' called the local time, the two coinciding only when k=1 and l=1.
propositions.quote: The variable t' may be called the local time ; indeed, for k=1, l=1 it becomes identical with what I have formerly understood by this name.

propositions.statement: There is a velocity of light c against which the velocity of translation w is compared as a ratio.
propositions.quote: which are proportional to the first power of the ratio between the velocity of translation w and the velocity of light c

propositions.name: earth_annual_motion
propositions.statement: The Earth possesses a translation shared by all terrestrial systems in virtue of its annual motion.
propositions.quote: The problem of determining the influence exerted on electric and optical phenomena by a translation, such as all systems have in virtue of the Earth's annual motion

propositions.name: velocity_smaller_than_light
propositions.statement: The velocity of translation must be smaller than the velocity of light, so that c^2 − w^2 remains positive.
propositions.quote: The only restriction as regards the velocity will be that it be smaller than that of light.

propositions.name: aether_exerts_force_on_electron
propositions.statement: The aether exerts an electric force per unit charge on volume-elements of electrons.
propositions.quote: the electric force, i.e. the force, reckoned per unit charge, which is exerted by the aether on a volume-element of an electron

propositions.name: electron_deformation_by_motion
propositions.statement: Electrons that are spheres of radius R in the state of rest have their dimensions in the direction of motion contracted by k when translated.
propositions.quote: I shall now suppose that the electrons, which I take to be spheres of radius R in the state of rest, have their dimensions changed by the effect of a translation

propositions.name: contraction_confined_to_motion_direction
propositions.statement: The translation only affects dimensions along the direction of motion, shortening them by the factor k relative to the state of rest.
propositions.quote: the influence of a translation on the dimensions (of the separate electrons and of a ponderable body as a whole) is confined to those that have the direction of the motion, these becoming k times smaller than they are in the state of rest

propositions.name: charge_preserved_under_deformation
propositions.statement: Under the deformation each element of volume preserves its charge.
propositions.quote: each element of volume is understood to preserve its charge

propositions.name: molecular_forces_transform_like_electric
propositions.statement: Forces between uncharged particles and between them and electrons are influenced by translation in the same way as electric forces in an electrostatic system.
propositions.quote: the forces between uncharged particles, as well as those between such particles and electrons, are influenced by a translation in quite the same way as the electric forces in an electrostatic system

propositions.name: single_configuration_of_equilibrium
propositions.statement: For a given system of attractions and repulsions there is only one configuration of equilibrium.
propositions.quote: if we take for granted that there is but one configuration of equilibrium

propositions.name: no_material_mass_of_electron
propositions.statement: The electron has no true or material mass; its only inertia is the electromagnetic longitudinal and transverse mass.
propositions.quote: I shall suppose that there is no other, no "true" or "material" mass

propositions.name: all_particle_masses_affected_by_translation
propositions.statement: The masses of all particles are influenced by translation in the same degree as the electromagnetic masses of the electrons.
propositions.quote: if we suppose that the masses of all particles are influenced by a translation to the same degree as the electromagnetic masses of the electrons

propositions.name: corresponding_state_is_realizable
propositions.statement: A state defined in the moving system by transforming a state that really exists in the system at rest must itself be a physically possible state.
propositions.quote: The question remains however, whether this state will likewise be a possible one.

propositions.name: d_prime_has_different_meaning_in_two_systems
propositions.statement: The vector d' represents the electric force in the system at rest but in the moving system it is only related to that force by an anisotropic factor.
propositions.quote: In Σ' it represents the electric force, in Σ it is related to this force in the way expressed by (20).

propositions.statement: Every electrostatic system moving with a velocity possesses a definite electromagnetic momentum.

propositions.name: torsion_balance_registers_couple
propositions.statement: A torsion balance sufficiently delicate would be deflected by the couple predicted for a moving charged condenser.
propositions.quote: In the apparatus of Trouton and Noble the condenser was fixed to the beam of a torsion-balance, sufficiently delicate to be deflected by a couple of the above order of magnitude.

propositions.name: uniform_surface_charge_at_rest
propositions.statement: The charge of an electron is uniformly distributed over its surface so long as the electron remains at rest.
propositions.quote: For simplicity's sake I shall suppose the charge e to be uniformly distributed over the surface, so long as the electron remains at rest.

propositions.name: retardation_by_r_over_c
propositions.statement: Potentials at a point are evaluated with source quantities taken at the earlier instant whose local time differs from t' by r'/c.

propositions.name: quasi_stationary_valid_for_optics
propositions.statement: The motion of an electron may be treated as quasi-stationary in optical phenomena because the electron's diameter is very small compared with the wavelength.
propositions.quote: This condition is fulfilled in optical phenomena, because the diameter of an electron is extremely small in comparison with the wave-length.

propositions.name: michelson_null_explained_by_contraction
propositions.statement: The negative result of Michelson's interference-experiment is explained by the alteration of dimensions of solid bodies produced by their motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: the negative result of which has led FitzGerald and myself to the conclusion that the dimensions of solid bodies are slightly altered by their motion through the aether

propositions.name: optical_earth_motion_undetectable_geometrically
propositions.statement: In experiments observing the geometrical distribution of light and darkness with a terrestrial source, the Earth's motion cannot produce a detectable influence.
propositions.quote: It will therefore be impossible to detect an influence of the Earth's motion on any optical experiment, made with a terrestrial source of light, in which the geometrical distribution of light and darkness is observed.

propositions.name: new_hypothesis_for_each_null_is_defect
propositions.statement: Requiring a new hypothesis to explain each fresh null experimental result is an unsatisfactory feature of the existing theory that fundamental assumptions ought to remove.
propositions.quote: in order to explain Michelsons 's negative result, the introduction of a new hypothesis has been required, and that the same necessity may occur each time new facts will be brought to light
